faq.q: What is the origin of Yasmin?
faq.a: Yasmin is associated with Arabic. Yasmin is Arabic يَاسْمِين (Yāsmīn), the word for the jasmine flower.
Yes — the underlying form يَاسْمِين is Arabic.
Yasmin can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
